inclusion_rule: gated is False/absent (accessible without a license click) AND >=1 *.safetensors file present AND params (safetensors.total, else estimated from config hidden_size/num_hidden_layers) <= 4.5e9 AND has a verified chat template (tokenizer_config.json contains literal key "chat_template" OR repo has chat_template.jinja) AND downloads >= 100 AND repo not in {Qwen/Qwen3-4B, Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Base, Qwen/Qwen3-4B-SafeRL, A_ABL}.
